trial_results:
Hosted API trial (2026-02-15 to 2026-02-28):
- Traffic shape: synthetic traffic + 30% production shadowing of peak day.
- Observed baseline QPS: 8 QPS during business hours; 15 QPS peak short bursts.
- Peak sustained window: 22 QPS for 10 minutes (spike test).
- Concurrency seen (requests in flight): average 6, 95th percentile 48 during promotional spike.
- Token mix: average prompt tokens 140, average completion tokens 560, avg total ~700 tokens per request. Embeddings comprise ~10% of total calls but 25% of token volume (batch embedding jobs).
- Latency: median 75ms for short responses, p95 for recommendation endpoints ~210ms on hosted trial (with prefix caching limited).
- Error rate: <0.5% transient timeouts, root cause identified as client-side retry config; SE recommended max retry backoff tweaks.
requirements_summary: Primary: low-latency recommendations (p50<80ms, p95<150ms target after dedicated tuning), predictable per-token cost, VPC with customer-managed KMS, SOC2 compliance proof. Secondary: embeddings for similarity search with nightly batch jobs; support for routing fallback to hosted during overflow. Must support A/B rollouts across model versions.
sizing_summary:
POC sizing notes and Redwood SE recommendation:
- Recommended baseline dedicated pool: 3 x NVIDIA H100 nodes (80GB) to cover expected steady state (30-40 QPS with 700-token avg) with room for batching and KV cache.
- Burst capacity: add 1 spare H100 for short promotional spikes or enable autoscale burst to cloud for additional 60 QPS.
- A100 option (if customer mandates): equivalent capacity ~6 x A100 80GB (higher per-node count, higher ops complexity).
- Expected concurrency per H100: ~16-20 concurrent user requests with ~700-token average before latency degradation.
- Caching: enable prefix/KV cache to reduce completion token cost ~15-25% on recommendation flows.
- Routing policy: primary -> dedicated; overflow -> hosted API with token-routing policy to preserve SLAs.
traffic_forecast:
Customer forecast provided during capacity call:
- Month 1 (post-commit): avg 12M requests/month -> ~8.4B tokens/month.
- Month 3: projected 18M requests/month -> ~12.6B tokens/month.
- Q4 projection (scale scenario): 40M requests/month -> ~28B tokens/month.
- Peak design target: 120 QPS sustained for 5 minutes (marketing flash sales).
- Growth assumptions: 25% QoQ; embedding batch size expected to double during Black Friday-type events.
- Redwood ask: confirm per-GPU throughput assumptions and cost per token for reserved tier to finalize sizing ROI.
pricing_feedback:
Customer is cost-sensitive; wants committed 12-month reserved pricing with clear per-token ceilings and an overage model. Key asks:
- include GPU-hour blended rate and token unit price in proposal,
- show delta between hosted incremental spend vs reserved capacity with 20%+ committed discount,
- option for quarterly true-up based on token throughput.
SE noted Redwood Optimize recommendations will reduce cost by caching and batching but customer wants conservative baseline pricing for financial planning.
objections_and_notes:
- Legal: data residency requirement for EU customers (need to know region-level hosting options).
- Ops: preference for H100 but procurement may push A100 due to internal partner contracts.
- Product: needs deterministic rollout (canary + auto-fallback) documented in SOW.
- Timeline risk: procurement calendar shows major spend approval not until 2026-06 unless Execs expedite.
